selected_script.angle: Messy post-walk muddy paw tracks solved instantly without water or tearing wipes
selected_script.hook: Muddy paws leaving tracks on the floor while a regular wet tissue tears in the owner's fingers during cleaning

script_record.pain_point: Active dogs bringing home muddy, dirty paws that stain the floor while standard thin wet wipes tear easily and fail to clean effectively without a messy full bath.
script_record.conflict_hook: Real-life frustrating moment showing a dog's dirty paws tracking dirt inside while the owner struggles with a flimsy regular wet wipe that rips apart.
script_record.product_solution: Owner quickly slips on the durable, thick PAWFIRST white five-finger cleaning glove wipe from the royal-blue pouch, easily gripping the paw and removing mud in seconds without water.

timeline.scene: Close-up handheld phone shot of a dog's dirty, muddy paws stepping onto a clean home floor. The owner tries to wipe the paw using a flimsy, thin regular wet tissue, but the tissue tears apart immediately in their fingers, leaving the dirt behind and causing frustration.

Quick cut to the owner picking up the royal-blue and orange PAWFIRST pouch, pulling out one white five-finger disposable glove wipe, and slipping it securely onto their hand. The raised pearl-textured dot surface on the thick nonwoven material is clearly visible.

Close-up action shot showing the gloved hand gently gripping the dog's muddy paw pad. The pearl-textured surface smoothly lifts away mud and dirt in one easy, precise wiping motion without any rinsing required, leaving the paw clean and soft.

Fast-cut to a different entryway setting right after a rainy walk. The owner uses the five-finger glove to comfortably wipe light mud splashes off the dog's chin and chest fur with exact ergonomic control while the calm dog stands relaxed.

Fast-cut to the final soothing grooming moment. The owner gently wipes along the dog's back coat and outer ear area. The thick, moist glove detangles and cleans while the calm, happy dog enjoys the gentle massage-like feeling.
Brief closing shot showing the clean, calm dog sitting happily next to the royal-blue PAWFIRST 2-pack retail pouch on a clean surface with clean paws clearly visible.

script_record.cta: Make daily pet cleanups quick and stress-free.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create the first 10-second segment of a vertical TikTok ad in a 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style. Use the exact product identity: PawFirst 12 Pcs Pet Cleaning Glove Wipes, featuring a white five-finger disposable nonwoven glove wipe with a raised pearl-textured dot surface, dispensed from a royal-blue rectangular pouch with an orange top header and clear white PAWFIRST lettering. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life close-up conflict scene where a dog's muddy paws leave dirty marks on a light indoor floor while an owner awkwardly tries to wipe the paw with a flimsy regular wet tissue that tears apart in their fingers, highlighting the frustration of mess and tearing wipes. 3-6s: Quickly introduce the solution as the owner takes out and slips on the thick, moist white PAWFIRST five-finger glove wipe from the royal-blue pouch, demonstrating its secure, ergonomic five-finger fit. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing the first clear result: the gloved hand gently and precisely wiping the dog's muddy paw pads clean in one smooth motion without water or rinsing, with the pearl-textured dots gripping the dirt easily while the calm dog stays comfortable. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep the pacing fast, natural, and product-focused. Show only calm animals using gentle wiping motions.

Create the continuation 10-second segment of a vertical TikTok ad in a 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style, preserving exact visual continuity with part 1. Keep the exact product identity, color, five-finger glove shape, pearl-like texture, white nonwoven material, royal-blue pouch design, pacing, and gentle usage logic. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2 in a different everyday usage environment at the home doorway right after an outdoor walk, showing the gloved hand gently wiping light dirt and moisture off the calm dog's chin and chest fur with precise fingertip control. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing the final result and comfort as the owner strokes down the dog's back coat and around the outer ear area, lifting surface dust while the calm pet visibly relaxes and enjoys the soothing grooming massage. 8-10s: Display the clean, calm dog sitting happily beside the royal-blue PAWFIRST retail pouch with crisp on-screen English text overlay saying 'Make daily pet cleanups quick and stress-free.'
